tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Search Storied Collection's historic exclusive-use venues (castles, estates, châteaux in Scotland, England, Wales, Ireland, France). All filters are optional and combined with AND. Prices are 'pricing from' per night in the venue's native currency (GBP or EUR) and are NEVER converted — max_price onl

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Get full details for one Storied Collection venue by name. Matching is fuzzy and accent-insensitive ('chateau challain', 'gilmerton', 'Borthwick'). Returns country, year originally built, pricing-from with its currency (never converted), rooms in main house, sleeps, guest house, minimum nights, heli

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List every country in the Storied Collection portfolio with the number of venues and the pricing currency used there.
